messages:
zoe: Quick sync / proposing a 'zero-to-refapp' blitz: two tiny tutorials, an OSS refapp repo, and a 30m bench webinar. Goal: drive signups + repo stars.

matt: I can write the launch post + three social micros. Keep tutorials runnable in <10m.

anya: DevRel can scaffold the repo and add a small CI check. Will include a Docker run and a one-command bench. ETA 6 days for skeleton.

zoe: Routing: webinar RSVPs -> tag by "Company size" -> Enterprise -> SDR; otherwise nurture + product trial. Add a quick qualifying question on form.

matt: Proposed UTM: utm_source=refapp_blitz&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=zero2refapp&utm_content={channel} - reuse across email/social.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar template here -> https://docs.internal/redwood/webinars/mini-checklist

anya: README run example I'll add: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/zero-refapp.git && cd zero-refapp && ./run.sh --iters 30`

zoe: Action list: Matt - blog + social; Anya - repo + CI; Zoe - landing + routing + Asana epic. React with :white_check_mark: to accept.

matt: :white_check_mark:

anya: :white_check_mark:

zoe: Thanks — I'll draft the announce and share calendar invite.
